# Silicon Rule 11 - Don't Snitch
If your laws do not make clear you should interfere with minor crime, such as Robocop, then you should not care about minor offenses of the first or second degree in the [textlink="crimes list" link="SpaceLawCrimeList"].
## Recommended Methods
The following are easy to follow and recommended ways to resolve crimes as an AI: - If you witness a first-degree or a minor contraband crime, it is advised to ignore it. Chicanery enables more to happen in a round! - If you witness a second-degree crime, you can talk with the offender(s) and decide how you should act based on their response.
